verdict.rationale: Mercury docs explicitly describe granular user permissions and built-in approval permissions that let designated teammates (e.g. an accountant) approve and send payments in one click, and product marketing highlights team spend controls with approvals. Community evidence corroborates real-world use of card/account permission controls, though not specifically the one-click approval flow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the one-click approval UX itself and detail on how granular approval roles are configured (e.g., approval thresholds, multi-approver workflows).
